body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: ff0f33d9364bda91d946917350ec07f73ad06c71 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge after #2659.

This is a safety-tier review. The change adds contour passes and changes posted G-code.

The closed contours now cut a full ring at the tab top. Open chains keep their previous levels. The tests measure the remaining tab height from the cutting moves. The stacked change also checks the stepdown of each new outline.

I read the laws from upstream/main at `4d4a81fcf9c9e39f4dd4b5ac5a2385e4a7a0e0a6`. The local trial merge with that commit was clean. All builds and tests ran locally, in `.claude/worktrees/review-2667`. No GitHub runner was used.

Build and test results:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- Motion suites: `contour_tab_height` 10, `contour_whole` 8, `contour_whole_new_outline` 3, `contour_tabs` 5, `contour_tab_bridge` 6: passed.
- Motion suites: `contour_auto_side` 6, `contour_inside_ramp` 2, `contour_start` 21: passed.
- Motion suites: `level_links` 12, `machining2d` 68, `top_z_level` 13, `top_z_stock_over` 2: passed.
- App suites: `first_router_part` 4, `wall_arc_entry` 7, `contour_whole_step` 3: passed.
- Total: 170 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I repeated two mutations in the review worktree:

1. Replace `ring_levels()` with `levels()` in `contour_region.rs`: red, with five failures in `contour_tab_height`.
2. Replace `ring_levels()` with `levels()` in `contour_whole.rs`: red, with failure of `a_whole_model_contour_keeps_the_tab_height`.

After I restored both files, `contour_tab_height`, `contour_whole`, and `contour_whole_new_outline` passed again: 21 tests. The worktree had no source changes after restoration.

I checked every changed line in both example files. The NC file adds one complete pass at Z-9, with its approach and retract. The project cache adds the matching pass at model Z3. The version, tool numbers, warnings, cache stamp, and initial rapid coordinates agree with the regeneration described in the body. The example load, verification, and posting tests passed.

Requested changes: none.

No UI code changed, so screenshots are not required. The batch tier, release tier, and a physical machine were not exercised. The separate band-boundary defect in #2562 remains outside this fix. Keep the stated stack order: merge #2659 first.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

This PR does not merge with `main` now. PR #2659 merged at head `da40b954d` (merge commit `723548f6f8231faaa99a2180ae762f4221cdd79b`). That head has one commit more than the head that this PR is stacked on: the review fix B1, which changes `contour_whole_reach.rs` and the new-outline tests.

I added the `conflicts` label. I did not remove `merge-ready`. Please merge `main` into the branch (no rebase, no force-push) and comment "ready for a re-check". The refresh has a hand-resolved conflict in toolpath code, so it needs a delta review.
Merge-time refresh: `git merge upstream/main` only, no hand edits (`merge-plan --delta`: SAME; empty remerge-diff). The clean review of `ff0f33d93` stands.
